capabilities: Import highlights and annotations from the Kobo Desktop App SQLite database or a copied Kobo SQLite file
Render book notes and highlight entries with customizable Eta.js templates
Preserve existing highlights in Obsidian using append-only sync
Detect a connected Kobo reader's database path on macOS or Windows
Fill notes with book metadata such as author, series, progress, and reading status
extras: Manual installation only (no community plugin store listing shown). README states it reads only the local Kobo SQLite database and sends no reading data to external servers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull reading highlights and annotations off a Kobo e-reader into notes.

relations.evidence: The plugin can read the local Kobo.sqlite database created by the Kobo Desktop App

summary: Imports highlights and annotations from a Kobo e-reader's SQLite database into Markdown notes in the vault.
